a.lede: While USB-C is the standard today, we saw a lot of phone charging ports before the days of Micro-USB and Mini-USB.
a.title: 5 old-school charging ports you probably forgot phones had before USB-C

b.lede: The truth is, there's no surprising meaning for the "A" in USB-A. Discover what this connector is used for and if it's becoming obsolete.
b.title: What's the meaning of the "A" on your USB-A ports?
